crossRefs.note: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.
A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.
They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.
When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, Yahweh, held me up.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Yahweh is your keeper. Yahweh is your shade on your right hand.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

translations.web: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by strength.
translations.bsb: He guards the steps of His faithful ones, but the wicked perish in darkness; for by his own strength shall no man prevail.
translations.kjv: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness; for by strength shall no man prevail.
translations.asv: He will keep the feet of his holy ones; But the wicked shall be put to silence in darkness; For by strength shall no man prevail.
